backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, team signups, merch store, and shopping cart functionality with role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: team signup form, merch shop, shopping cart, admin dashboard, and gaming-themed visual design with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing components, pages, hooks, and styling for the Savage Elite gaming application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for a gaming aesthetic with grayscale and accent colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference for the React application titled 'Savage Elite'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for shop, signup, cart, and admin pages, wrapped in dark theme provider with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied UI component displaying a red-themed error message with shield icon for unauthorized admin area access attempts.
Admin component rendering a table of all team signup applications with gamer tag, email, role, and experience level columns, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/Cart.tsx: Shopping cart component displaying cart items with total price calculation, clear cart button, and checkout button, with empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/CartItem.tsx: Displays a single cart item with image, name, price, quantity controls (increment/decrement/delete), and subtotal. Uses mutation hook to update cart item quantities.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header containing logo, navigation (Shop, Join Team, Cart, Admin), and login button. Conditionally shows ProfileSetupModal for authenticated users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that toggles between login and logout states using Internet Identity. Clears query cache on logout and handles loading/disabled states.
frontend/src/components/MerchCard.tsx: Displays a merchandise item card with image, name, description, price, and add-to-cart button. Shows temporary success state after adding item to cart.
frontend/src/components/MerchGrid.tsx: Grid container that fetches and displays all merchandise items using MerchCard components. Handles loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time users to create their profile by entering name and gamer tag. Blocks interaction until profile is created.
frontend/src/components/TeamSignupForm.t: Form for users to apply to join the gaming team with fields for gamer tag, email, preferred role (Tank/DPS/Support/etc), and experience level. Submits application via mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, team signups, merch items, and shopping cart management with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom design tokens for a dark gaming theme using Rajdhani and Orbitron fonts, plus utility classes for red/green glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers wrapping the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only page that displays the signup list component after verifying caller admin status, showing access denied screen for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Shopping cart page that requires authentication, displaying the Cart component for logged-in users or a login prompt otherwise.
frontend/src/pages/MerchShop.tsx: Public merchandise store page displaying the MerchGrid component with a themed header for browsing available items.
frontend/src/pages/TeamSignup.tsx: Team application page that requires authentication, shows existing submission status if present, or displays the signup form for new applications.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, custom fonts (Rajdhani, Orbitron), glow shadow effects, and animation keyframes for accordion components.
project_state.json: Project state file for 'Savage Elite' gaming team signup and merch shop app, tracking 6 implemented features including signup form, merch shop, cart functionality, admin interface, gaming-themed design, and static asset display.
